_about: Public-domain Henry Rogers (1806-1877), Congregational apologist and essayist, for the Word Hoard: Reason and Faith (1850), The Life and Character of John Howe (1836; 1850 printing), Essays selected from the Edinburgh Review (1850), The Eclipse of Faith (1853), A Defence of the Eclipse of Faith (1854) and Selections from the Correspondence of R. E. H. Greyson (1857). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hrogers-reason-and-faith: Reason and faith : their claims and conflicts, with an appendix, containing some additional remarks on the characteristics of Strauss' "Life of Jesus (London : Longman, Brown, Green, and Longmans, 1850)
hrogers-john-howe: The life and character of John Howe, with an analysis of his writings (London, 1850)
hrogers-essays: Essays, selected from contributions to the Edinburgh review (London, Longman, 1850)
hrogers-eclipse-of-faith: The eclipse of faith, or, A visit to a religious sceptic (Boston : Crosby, Nichols, 1853)
hrogers-defence-eclipse: A defence of "The eclipse of faith" (Boston : Crosby, Nichols, 1854)
hrogers-greyson-letters: The Greyson letters: selections from the correspondence of R. E. H. Greyson, esq. [pseud.] (Boston, Gould and Lincoln; New York, Sheldon, Blakeman & Co.; [etc., etc.], 1857)

_excluded.hrogers-other: Henry Rogers the American geologist and other Henry Rogerses

_identity_checked.hrogers-defence-eclipse: published anonymously: title page 'A Defence of "The Eclipse of Faith," by its author'; the Princeton library card reads 'Rogers, Henry, 1806-1877', and The Eclipse of Faith on this shelf is his
